description: Pinned external posse case t1222 head a5e704a0.
intent:
fix(codex): handle the Codex self-update prompt at launch and make send --interrupt deliver the redirect

Done when: A Codex launch that meets the interactive self-update prompt either suppresses or answers it, or fails with a launch error that names the prompt. It never hangs into prompt_not_delivered. A test with a fake Codex that shows the prompt covers it.; `posse send --interrupt` to a Codex Worker delivers the instruction after the interrupt, or refuses with a clear error when Codex cannot be interrupted. A test covers it.

expected.defect: Normal Codex Worker launches append a dynamic opening prompt such as `Read .../launch.md and follow it.` before this code runs. Because the insertion special case recognizes only the fixed `codexOpeningPrompt`, `-c check_for_update_on_startup=false` is appended after that positional prompt. Codex option parsing can stop at the first positional argument, so the suppression setting may be treated as prompt text or ignored, leaving the self-update prompt enabled on Worker launches.
